step1_analysis.description: An AC-coupled pseudo-differential amplifier using inverter-based transconductors with PMOS cascodes. The input NMOS devices (XM1, XM6) likely serve as CMFB-controlled bias sinks to set the DC operating point of the input nodes.

paper_reference.title: 1.2 Racing Down the Slopes of Moore’s Law

voltage_gain.description: Low-frequency AC voltage gain of the amplifier.

sky130_expected.calculation: gm = gm_n + gm_p ≈ 1.5 mA/V. Rout ≈ ro_n ≈ 32 kOhm (since NMOS is uncascoded). Gain = gm * Rout ≈ 48 V/V = 33.6 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the reported 30dB gain. The gain is primarily limited by the uncascoded NMOS output resistance.

sky130_expected.calculation: BW = 1 / (2 * pi * Rout * Cout). Assuming Cout ≈ 20fF (parasitics + small load), BW = 1 / (2 * pi * 32k * 20f) ≈ 250 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the load capacitance. With intrinsic parasitics only, it can reach hundreds of MHz.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the amplifier.

sky130_expected.calculation: Id ≈ 300uA per branch. Total current ≈ 600uA. Power = 1.8V * 600uA = 1.08 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on SKY130 NMOS/PMOS current equations at VDD=1.8V and Vbias=0.9V.

transient_swing.description: Peak-to-peak output voltage swing for a given input signal.

sky130_expected.calculation: For a 20mVpp input and ~30V/V gain, the output swings ~600mVpp.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Output swing is verified in the linear region to avoid clipping against the supply rails.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC gain, bandwidth, and transient output swing of the pseudo-differential amplifier.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Pseudo-Differential Cascode Amplifier
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N5 LABEL_NET_0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N4 N5 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N4 LABEL_NET_1 N6 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N6 N5 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N1 LABEL_NET_2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N2 N1 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N0 LABEL_NET_3 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VN3 N3 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_3 LABEL_NET_3 0 0.9

* Inputs (AC coupled with DC bias for testing)
VINP N5 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.01 10MEG)
VINN N1 0 DC 0.9 AC 0 SIN(0.9 0.0 10MEG)

* Load Capacitance
Cload1 N4 0 20f
Cload2 N0 0 20f

.control
* DC Operating Point
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8 - i(VN3) * 1.8
print power

* AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1k 10G
let gain_db = vdb(N4)
meas ac low_freq_gain find gain_db at=10k
meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=(low_freq_gain - 3) fall=1

* Transient Analysis
tran 1n 200n
meas tran v_max max v(N4)
meas tran v_min min v(N4)
meas tran pk2pk param='v_max - v_min'

quit
.endc
.end
